mapper.select: select count(1) from flow_task where approver_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
select count(1) from crm_customer where date_format(create_time,'%y%m') = date_format(now(),'%y%m')
select count(1) from biz_quote where date_format(create_time,'%y%m') = date_format(now(),'%y%m')
select ifnull(sum(contract_amount), 0) from biz_contract where status in ('2', '3', '4') and date_format(sign_date,'%y%m') = date_format(now(),'%y%m')
select ifnull(sum(amount), 0) from biz_deposit where status <> '3' and date_format(pay_time,'%y%m') = date_format(now(),'%y%m')
select count(1) from biz_payment_plan where status = '1' and plan_date < curdate()
select count(1) from biz_drawing where status = '0' and is_current = '1'
select count(1) from biz_payment_plan where status = '1'
select count(1) from biz_expense where status = '2'
select count(1) from biz_inventory i inner join biz_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id where m.status = '0' and i.quantity <= m.safety_stock

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from crm_customer where create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(follow_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from crm_follow_record where follow_type = '3' and follow_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and follow_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by date_format(follow_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from biz_quote where create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from biz_deposit where status <> '3' and pay_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and pay_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from biz_payment_record where pay_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and pay_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select ifnull(dt.dict_label, ifnull(c.source, '未填写')) as name, count(1) as value from crm_customer c left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'crm_customer_source' and dt.dict_value = c.source where c.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and c.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by ifnull(dt.dict_label, ifnull(c.source, '未填写')) order by value desc
select status, count(1) as cnt, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from biz_deposit where pay_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and pay_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by status

select ifnull(dt.dict_label, d.drawing_type) as name, count(1) as value from biz_drawing d left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'biz_drawing_type' and dt.dict_value = d.drawing_type where d.is_current = '1'
and d.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and d.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
group by ifnull(dt.dict_label, d.drawing_type) order by value desc

select ifnull(dt.dict_label, s.status) as name, count(1) as value from biz_site s left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'biz_site_status' and dt.dict_value = s.status group by ifnull(dt.dict_label, s.status)

select s.site_id as siteId, s.site_no as siteNo, s.status, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, ifnull(dt.dict_label, s.status) as statusLabel, s.area, s.designer_name as designerName, s.supervisor_name as supervisorName, s.start_date as actualStart, agg.plan_start_date as planStart, agg.plan_end_date as planEnd, s.finish_date as finishDate, agg.done_stages as doneStages, agg.total_stages as totalStages, (select ifnull(ifnull(ps2.stage_name, dt2.dict_label), '施工中') from biz_progress_stage ps2 left join sys_dict_data dt2 on dt2.dict_type = 'biz_stage_type' and dt2.dict_value = ps2.stage_type where ps2.site_id = s.site_id and ps2.status = '1' order by ps2.sort_order limit 1) as currentStage from biz_site s inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = s.customer_id left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'biz_site_status' and dt.dict_value = s.status left join ( select ps.site_id, min(ps.plan_start_date) as plan_start_date, max(ps.plan_end_date) as plan_end_date, sum(case when ps.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as done_stages, count(1) as total_stages from biz_progress_stage ps group by ps.site_id ) agg on agg.site_id = s.site_id order by s.status, agg.plan_start_date

select ifnull(ifnull(ps.stage_name, dt.dict_label), '其他') as name, count(1) as value from biz_progress_stage ps inner join biz_site s on s.site_id = ps.site_id and s.status = '1' left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'biz_stage_type' and dt.dict_value = ps.stage_type where ps.status = '1' group by ifnull(ifnull(ps.stage_name, dt.dict_label), '其他') order by value desc
select count(1) as cnt, ifnull(sum(contract_amount), 0) as amount from biz_contract where status in ('2', '3', '4') and sign_date >= #{beginTime} and sign_date <= #{endTime}

select date_format(sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as cnt, ifnull(sum(contract_amount), 0) as amount from biz_contract where status in ('2', '3', '4') and sign_date >= #{beginTime} and sign_date <= #{endTime} group by date_format(sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select ifnull(dt.dict_label, '未评级') as name, count(1) as value from crm_customer c left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'crm_intention_level' and dt.dict_value = c.intention_level where c.status in ('1', '2', '3') group by ifnull(dt.dict_label, '未评级'), c.intention_level order by field(ifnull(c.intention_level, 'Z'), 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'Z')

select concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, c.intention_level as intentionLevel, q.final_amount as finalAmount, q.create_time as quoteTime, d.deposit_amount as depositAmount from crm_customer c inner join ( select customer_id, max(quote_id) as quote_id from biz_quote group by customer_id ) latest on latest.customer_id = c.customer_id inner join biz_quote q on q.quote_id = latest.quote_id left join ( select customer_id, sum(amount) as deposit_amount from biz_deposit where status in ('0', '1') group by customer_id ) d on d.customer_id = c.customer_id where c.status in ('1', '2', '3') and q.status in ('0', '1', '2') order by field(ifnull(c.intention_level, 'Z'), 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'Z'), q.final_amount desc limit 50

select concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, ct.contract_no as contractNo, p.period_no as periodNo, p.period_name as periodName, p.plan_amount as planAmount, p.plan_date as planDate from biz_payment_plan p inner join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = p.contract_id inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id where p.status = '1' and p.plan_date between curdate() and date_add(curdate(), interval 7 day) order by p.plan_date
select count(1) as cnt, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as amount from biz_payment_record where pay_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and pay_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')

select concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, r.follow_time as followTime, r.visit_count as visitCount, ifnull(dt.dict_label, r.visit_purpose) as purposeLabel from crm_follow_record r inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = r.customer_id left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'crm_visit_purpose' and dt.dict_value = r.visit_purpose where r.follow_type = '3' and r.follow_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and r.follow_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by r.follow_time desc limit 20

select date_format(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, ifnull(dt.dict_label, ifnull(c.source, '未知')) as source from crm_customer c left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'crm_customer_source' and dt.dict_value = c.source where c.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and c.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by c.create_time

select date_format(r.follow_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, r.visit_count as visitCount, ifnull(dt.dict_label, ifnull(r.visit_purpose, '')) as purpose from crm_follow_record r inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = r.customer_id left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'crm_visit_purpose' and dt.dict_value = r.visit_purpose where r.follow_type = '3' and r.follow_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and r.follow_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by r.follow_time

select date_format(q.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, q.final_amount as amount from biz_quote q inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = q.customer_id where q.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and q.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by q.create_time

select date_format(d.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, d.amount, ifnull(dt.dict_label, d.status) as statusLabel from biz_deposit d inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = d.customer_id left join sys_dict_data dt on dt.dict_type = 'biz_deposit_status' and dt.dict_value = d.status where d.pay_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and d.pay_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by d.pay_time

select date_format(ct.sign_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, ct.contract_amount as amount, (select s.designer_name from biz_site s where s.customer_id = ct.customer_id limit 1) as designer from biz_contract ct inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id where ct.status in ('2', '3', '4') and ct.sign_date >= #{beginTime} and ct.sign_date <= #{endTime} order by ct.sign_date

select date_format(p.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, concat(c.customer_name, if(c.estate is null or c.estate = '', '', concat('（', c.estate, '）'))) as customer, p.amount from biz_payment_record p inner join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = p.contract_id inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id where p.pay_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and p.pay_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by p.pay_time

select d.designer_name as designer, ifnull(sign.cnt, 0) as signCount, ifnull(sign.amount, 0) as signAmount, ifnull(runningSite.cnt, 0) as runningSiteCount, ifnull(doneSite.cnt, 0) as doneSiteCount, ifnull(drawing.cnt, 0) as drawingCount from ( select distinct designer_name from biz_site where designer_name is not null and designer_name != '' ) d left join ( select s.designer_name, count(1) as cnt, ifnull(sum(ct.contract_amount), 0) as amount from biz_contract ct inner join biz_site s on s.customer_id = ct.customer_id where ct.status in ('2','3','4') and ct.sign_date >= #{beginTime} and ct.sign_date <= #{endTime} group by s.designer_name ) sign on sign.designer_name = d.designer_name left join ( select designer_name, count(1) as cnt from biz_site where status = '1' group by designer_name ) runningSite on runningSite.designer_name = d.designer_name left join ( select designer_name, count(1) as cnt from biz_site where status = '2' group by designer_name ) doneSite on doneSite.designer_name = d.designer_name left join ( select s.designer_name, count(1) as cnt from biz_drawing dr inner join biz_site s on s.customer_id = dr.customer_id where dr.is_current = '1' and dr.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and dr.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by s.designer_name ) drawing on drawing.designer_name = d.designer_name order by ifnull(sign.amount, 0) desc

select t.salesman, ifnull(cust.cnt, 0) as customerCount, ifnull(sign.cnt, 0) as signCount, ifnull(sign.amount, 0) as signAmount, ifnull(visit.cnt, 0) as visitCount, ifnull(quote.cnt, 0) as quoteCount from ( select distinct owner_name as salesman from crm_customer where owner_name is not null and owner_name != '' and create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') ) t left join ( select c.owner_name as salesman, count(1) as cnt from crm_customer c where c.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and c.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by c.owner_name ) cust on cust.salesman = t.salesman left join ( select c.owner_name as salesman, count(1) as cnt, ifnull(sum(ct.contract_amount), 0) as amount from biz_contract ct inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = ct.customer_id where ct.status in ('2','3','4') and ct.sign_date >= #{beginTime} and ct.sign_date <= #{endTime} group by c.owner_name ) sign on sign.salesman = t.salesman left join ( select c.owner_name as salesman, count(1) as cnt from crm_follow_record r inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = r.customer_id where r.follow_type = '3' and r.follow_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and r.follow_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by c.owner_name ) visit on visit.salesman = t.salesman left join ( select c.owner_name as salesman, count(1) as cnt from biz_quote q inner join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = q.customer_id where q.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00') and q.create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59') group by c.owner_name ) quote on quote.salesman = t.salesman order by ifnull(sign.amount, 0) desc
